name: branding-lightning-monogram-sports-identity-grid
title: Forest green and neon lime sports identity with lightning-Z mark
whatItIs: A grid of tiles: the lime lightning-Z symbol and wordmark 'Prime Zone' on deep green, a runner crossing a street with the mark drawn as a white outline, lime branded tape, a green tote with the mark, and a lime-to-green gradient card with the tagline 'Performance Begins in the Prime Zone.'
whatItMeans: Energetic and disciplined; neon lime on deep green feels like performance gear.
techniques: Use a bold bolt-shaped monogram that can be drawn as a line on photos.
Pair neon lime with deep forest green.
Apply the mark to tape and tote for tactile branding.
Set a tagline with italic emphasis on the key phrase.

vocabulary.definition: A logo drawn as an outline over a photo.
Adhesive tape printed with a logo pattern.
A tagline with an italic key phrase.
